visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female creator with shoulder-length black hair, wearing a green V-neck t-shirt and a small necklace, speaks directly to the camera with friendly facial expressions. She is positioned in an indoor kitchen or bathroom with white cabinets and bright lighting. (2) She holds a white tube of BB cream labeled 'cozywhite' and squeezes the beige product onto her fingers. She then applies it to her face using her hands, rubbing it in to demonstrate the product's texture and ease of use in the same indoor setting. (3) A close-up view focuses on her face, highlighting the skin's texture before and after application. She uses a black-and-white beauty blender sponge around her nose area. The lighting shifts as she turns a lamp off to show the product's appearance in dim light. (4) A series of shots show the creator's face at intervals of 1, 3, 4, 6, 7, and 8 hours. These shots take place both indoors and outdoors in a park-like street setting with trees and natural daylight. (5) The creator is seen in a different room with blue floral wallpaper, wearing a white v-neck shirt and gesturing towards promotional text overlays. Her expression is energetic as she delivers a final message to the audience.
